_comment: Read by the in-app update notice (issue #106). Served from GitHub Pages
by .github/workflows/deploy-manual.yml, which publishes landing/ on every
Bump a channel ONLY once that channel's release is actually downloadable.
The GitHub-hosted channels (dmg, win, linux, apk) go live when release.sh
publishes the release; the store channels (mas, ios, play) lag behind by
however long review takes, and must not be bumped until the listing shows
the new build — otherwise the notice sends people to a store page still
offering the version they already have.
